verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm with a small-business/start-ups practice and a J-1 incubator pathway, so this story applies to it. However, nothing in the evidence explains how a founder's own startup can petition for them. Beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer control arrangements, and the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance are never mentioned; the startup and incubator pages are adjacent material, not this capability.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents how my own startup can petition for me — beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer control arrangements, and the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance
